thread:
maria (infra): FYI — after the CUDA 12 toolkit push to eu-west pools we're seeing a rash of OOMs and NCCL timeouts, plus a handful of PCIe link reset errors. Not typical memory-only OOMs, nodes are getting destabilized. :grimacing:

jason (eng-sre): ugh. saw similar in canary last night but we assumed it was the new kernel modules. do you have a sample pod log?

maria (infra): paste/log below:

```
[2026-03-17T03:12:45Z] gpu0: pcie: link reset detected
[2026-03-17T03:12:45Z] tensorflow: runtime error: NCCL_E_TIMEOUT
[2026-03-17T03:12:46Z] container runtime: sigabrt (tcmalloc) with stack trace
[2026-03-17T03:12:46Z] ld.so: warning: object '/usr/local/cuda-12/lib64/libcudart.so.12' has different build-id
```

maria (infra): Also seeing this in the provisioning logs when we rebuild images with the new toolchain: some containers fail fast during CUDA init.

vikram (runtime): two suspects: (1) mixed host driver vs toolkit mismatch (driver < 525 with cu12 is sketchy), (2) gcc/abi mismatch from our new builder image using gcc13 causing libstdc++/CXXABI differences.

ana (oncall): tagging infra oncall @ana — can you take a look at the failing node set eu-west-2a-prod-gpu-*(50-60)? They hit a provisioning retry loop.

ana (oncall): quick note: I saw modprobe nvidia-uvm fail on one host with 'invalid module format' after the system kernel patch, need to confirm driver binary compatibility.

kevin (provisioning): provisioning traces show the container rebuild job starts fine then fails during package ldconfig step with errors: "relocation error: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6: symbol _ZNSaIcEC1Ev not found" — looks like mixed libstdc++.

jason (eng-sre): that symbol is from a newer ABI. our node images still ship libstdc++ from distro gcc11. If the container brings gcc13-built libs, we get runtime symbol mismatches. We need to enforce multi-stage link freshness or force container to use system libs via --no-ldconfig hack.

maria (infra): What's puzzling is the PCIe link resets. Could that be causing NCCL instability or are we seeing independent hardware flakiness?

vikram (runtime): PCIe resets correlate with heavy p2p NCCL traffic when batching spikes. With the cu12 runtime, power management behavior changed and we've seen some vendors push different firmware. I'm leaning toward a combination: cu12 exposes a sequence that trips older PCIe firmware causing link retrain and then NCCL timeouts.

jason (eng-sre): timeline: we rolled cu12 images to eu-west canary 03:00, rolled to prod pool 03:30. First OOM/NCCL reports at 03:12 (canary) and 03:40 (prod).

maria (infra): immediate mitigation: (A) pin the pool to cuda-toolkit:11.8 container tag (rollback images), (B) cordon the most flappy hosts and repro on a dedicated debug pool, (C) add a temporary NCCL_DISABLE_P2P=1 env to reduce p2p pressure. Thoughts?

kevin (provisioning): we can rollback image tag within the autoscaling group in ~10m, but that won't fix containers that already started and got stuck in rebuild loops. We'll need to kill and let new instances pick pinned image.

ana (oncall): set NCCL_DISABLE_P2P=1 as a stopgap, that reduces throughput but should stop the link resets if p2p is the trigger. I'll push a k8s rollout patch to the inference namespace now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started — rollout: inference/worker (env patch) by ana — 6/120 pods updated.

jason (eng-sre): also adding a taint to the problematic hosts: kubectl taint nodes eu-west-2a-prod-* gpu-provisioning-fault=true:NoSchedule

maria (infra): long-term: we need a multi-dimensional compatibility matrix in the console showing driver version, kernel versions, firmware versions, and expected toolkit support. This could've prevented the surprise. Filing a ticket.

vikram (runtime): agreed. Also need standard builder images pinned to distro libstdc++ or use static linking for runtime libs. I'll open an RFC for builder image policy.

kevin (provisioning): cost note: rollback + draining + re-provisioning will spike provisioning churn and transient GPU-hour waste. Estimate ~120 GPU-hours extra in eu-west during the rollback window.

ana (oncall): can we restrict heavy model runs (long context) during the mitigation window? throttling routes at the API gateway would buy us time.

maria (infra): API throttle in place for low-priority routes. High-priority customers still on dedicated capacity unaffected.

jason (eng-sre): follow-up debug commands for anyone investigating the node:

```
# check pcie errors
dmesg | grep -i pcie
# check nvidia driver vs toolkit
modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic
ldd /usr/local/cuda-12/bin/nvcc | grep libstdc++
```

vikram (runtime): repro plan: (1) spin up two nodes with driver 520 + firmware X, deploy a small NCCL ring test with cu12, run heavy p2p allreduce, watch for link retrain. (2) repeat with driver 525+ and alternate firmware. Will run tonight in staging.

maria (infra): action items: ana to roll patch (NCCL_DISABLE_P2P), kevin to start image rollback plan, vikram to run repro in staging and collect PCIe logs, jason to coordinate node cordon and tainting, maria to open compatibility matrix ticket.

ana (oncall): Done: rollout completed — 120/120 pods now have NCCL_DISABLE_P2P=1. Observed immediate drop in NCCL timeouts.

kevin (provisioning): starting rollback of image tag; ETA 12 minutes for full group recycle.

maria (infra): thanks team. keep monitoring for any PCIe resets after the rollback. If we still see resets, we escalate to HW vendor (firmware).

jason (eng-sre): logging note: add a small log hook in the node exporter to capture pcie link retrain events and push them to the infra-dash for trending — I'll PR now.

maria (infra): btw — discovered one host with mismatched driver package (leftover from manual upgrade). We'll drain it and repro.

vikram (runtime): will share the repro artifacts and kernel oops trace once staging run completes.

maria (infra): creating incident ticket INC-2026-0417 and linking notes. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI pipeline failed on builder-image-gcc13: see https://ci.internal/builds/3245 — linking to the container rebuild errors.

maria (infra): ok let's reconvene after staging repro — thanks all.

ana (oncall): leaving note: monitoring alerts quieting, but still watching for any new OOM spikes.
